title: Chancellor Pradeep K. Khosla - UC San Diego (Plexuss Presidential Podcast, Episode 21)
snippet: In Episode 21 of the Plexuss Presidential Podcast, Dr. JP Novin sits down with Dr. Pradeep K. Khosla, Chancellor of UC San Diego, to explore one of the biggest questions facing higher education and society. As AI continues to transform the workforce, Chancellor Khosla explains why access to these technologies may determine who benefits most from the next era of innovation.
match_reason: websearch (podcast) — The podcast episode features Pradeep K. Khosla, Chancellor of UC San Diego, discussing how artificial intelligence is reshaping higher education and the workforce.
